description: Layer 3 Process Timeline: synchronized multi-parameter RCA. temperature → humidity → scan_speed → air_vacuum → scale_x/y → pe_1~6 → je_1~4 → state. Shared crosshair + tooltip. Fixed axis scaling.

panels.description: temperature per machine. Fixed axis 18-28°C (target 22±2°C). Shared crosshair syncs with all panels below.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, 
eqp_id AS metric, 
AVG(temperature)::NUMERIC AS value 

FROM
   public.ldi_data 

WHERE
   factory IN ($Factory) 

  AND  $__timeFilter(time) 

  AND  process IN ($process) 

  AND  eqp_id IN (${Eqp:singlequote}) 

  AND  temperature IS NOT NULL 

GROUP BY
   1, 2 

ORDER BY
   1

panels.description: Machine lifesign: GREEN = RUNNING (state=true), RED = DOWN (state=false). Full-width panel for instant visibility of machine availability.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
   time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, eqp_id AS metric, MAX(CASE WHEN state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS value 
FROM
   public.ldi_data 
WHERE
   factory IN ($Factory) 
  AND  $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND  process IN ($process) 
  AND  eqp_id IN (${Eqp:singlequote}) 
GROUP BY
   1, 2 
ORDER BY
   1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT

FROM
   public.v_machine_spc_ranking
